blurb: Stash 13.0.1 is the April 2020 release of Morgan Houppin's C UCI chess engine, adding selectivity to its PVS and transposition-table core through null move pruning with zugzwang verification, static exchange evaluation, and initial late move reductions. Adapted to UCI over WASI on the poll helper.
fidelityNotes: Single-threaded plain wasm32-wasip1 build using the C poll helper; Hash capped for 32-bit memory. Native bench uses a fixed 1 ms thread-startup wait, so comparison uses positions.

features.label: Magic Bitboards
features.implementation: 64-bit magic bitboards for bishop and rook sliding-piece attacks.

features.label: Iterative Deepening
features.implementation: Iterative root search with transposition-table seeding and a UCI bench command.

features.label: PVS
features.implementation: Negamax PVS with null-window probes and re-searches on fail-high.

features.label: Quiescence Search
features.implementation: Horizon capture and promotion search with stand-pat cutoffs.

features.label: Null Move Pruning
features.implementation: Null-move pruning with zugzwang verification search when non-pawn material is low.

features.label: Late Move Reductions
features.implementation: Fixed two-ply depth reduction on late moves with full-depth re-search on fail-high.

features.label: SEE
features.implementation: Static exchange evaluation threshold checks (`see_greater_than`) for tactical filtering.

features.label: Hash Move & MVV-LVA
features.implementation: Transposition-table move prioritized ahead of MVV-LVA captures and PSQT-ordered quiet moves.

features.label: Transposition Table
features.implementation: Zobrist-indexed hash table storing search bounds, depths, and best moves.

features.label: Tapered PSQT Eval
features.implementation: Incrementally maintained middlegame and endgame piece-square scores interpolated by remaining material.
